opportunities.name: AP gravity artillery
opportunities.objective: Test ap gravity artillery against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: GravitumQ's helper calculation has 0.7 AP and Moonlight Vigil's initial physical blast has 1.0 AP; Nashor and Lich Bane preserve some normal attack pressure. This tests a mixed weapon spell pattern rather than claiming AP strengthens every gun attack.
opportunities.requiredState: Gravitum available for root setup and a favorable off-hand pair.
opportunities.failure: Ammo rotation makes the desired spell unavailable; physical R resists magic penetration.
opportunities.test: Measure Gravitum spell and R initial damage separately for each weapon pair.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Primary Q tooltip is symbolic; helper presence alone does not verify dispatch or turret item inheritance.

opportunities.name: Weapon spell endurance
opportunities.objective: Test weapon spell endurance against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Weapon-specific Q casts and the physical Moonlight Vigil blast favor AD and ability haste; Shojin supports spell repetitions while Hexplate rewards the ultimate with attack speed and movement. Cleaver serves physical attacks and spell packets; Bloodthirster supplies attack sustain during the rotation. Death's Dance protects the physical trade window instead of an incompatible Last Whisper purchase.
opportunities.requiredState: Plan ammo transitions before fighting, with enough space to attack after R.
opportunities.failure: Missing crit and attack speed can lose standard weapon burst.
opportunities.test: Compare two complete weapon rotations and total physical damage at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Severum flurries and sentry shots require individual trigger checks; no universal six-hit item claim.

ruledOut.reason: Primary Q tooltip is symbolic; helper presence alone does not verify dispatch or turret item inheritance.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.name: AP gravity artillery
builds.summary: Test ap gravity artillery against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test ap gravity artillery against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: GravitumQ's helper calculation has 0.7 AP and Moonlight Vigil's initial physical blast has 1.0 AP; Nashor and Lich Bane preserve some normal attack pressure. This tests a mixed weapon spell pattern rather than claiming AP strengthens every gun attack.
testPlan: Required state: Gravitum available for root setup and a favorable off-hand pair.
Measure Gravitum spell and R initial damage separately for each weapon pair.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Ammo rotation makes the desired spell unavailable; physical R resists magic penetration.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Primary Q tooltip is symbolic; helper presence alone does not verify dispatch or turret item inheritance.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Aphelios fires a concentrated blast of moonlight that explodes when it hits a champion, dealing [125 / 175 / 225 + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] physical damage to surrounding enemies.

Then, Aphelios attacks all champions hit with his main-hand weapon. {{ Spell_ApheliosR_WeaponMod_@f1@ }}
Swap main-hand and off-hand weapons, equipping {{ ApheliosGun_LoreName_@f1@ }}.
